tools.description:
Run the provided Python code to generate a static matplotlib chart.
The resulting chart is returned as a base64 encoded image.

output.description: A dictionary with the following keys: base64_image, logs, error

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
x = np.linspace(0, 10, 100)
y = np.sin(x)
plt.plot(x, y)
plt.title('Sine Wave')
plt.xlabel('X-axis')
plt.ylabel('Y-axis')
plt.savefig('/tmp/sine_wave.png')

summary:
## E2B Toolkit

The E2B toolkit integrates [E2B](https://e2b.dev) sandboxed code execution into Arcade, enabling LLMs to run arbitrary code and generate visualizations in a secure, isolated environment.

## Capabilities

- **Sandboxed code execution**: Run code snippets and capture stdout/stderr output without risk to the host environment.
- **Matplotlib chart generation**: Execute Python code that produces static matplotlib figures; results are returned as base64-encoded images ready for display or further processing.

## Secrets

This toolkit requires the following secret:

- `E2B_API_KEY`: An API key issued by E2B that authenticates requests to their sandbox API. Obtain it by signing in to the [E2B dashboard](https://e2b.dev/dashboard), navigating to **API Keys**, and creating a new key. A free tier is available; higher usage limits require a paid plan. The key is a long alphanumeric string prefixed with `e2b_`.

Configure secrets in Arcade at [https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets) or via the [Arcade secrets dashboard](https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets).
